verdict.rationale: RingCentral's Business SMS Booster add-on is described as including 'compliance tools' for customer texting. That is the product's own SMS-compliance capability, but nothing in the evidence says it handles STOP/HELP keywords automatically or suppresses opted-out contacts from future sends. Missing for 10: explicit automatic STOP/HELP keyword handling, opt-out suppression list behavior, API or docs detail on opt-out management, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
